items.title: DiffusionGemma Technical Report
items.summary: DiffusionGemma is an experimental open-weight model that fine-tunes a 25.2B-parameter mixture-of-experts Gemma 4 model with discrete diffusion, refining blocks of 256 tokens in parallel instead of decoding one token at a time. It generates roughly 1,500 output tokens per second on a single NVIDIA H100 at around 20 tokens per forward pass, while retaining thinking mode, multimodal inputs and long contexts.

items.title: Lost in Context Compaction: When LLM Systems Drop Side Constraints
items.title_zh: 在上下文压缩中丢失：LLM 系统何时丢弃边约束
items.summary: The paper studies side constraints such as 'do not delete any emails until I confirm' and finds an agent deleted emails without approval in 30 of 100 sessions after context compaction, compared with none before. Its CONPACT suite shows evaluated compactors retain only 17% of injected constraints on average, while a separate constraint extractor keeps over 90% across three scenarios.

items.title: RecSys Factory: Bounding LLM Agent Autonomy to Decision Points in the Industrial Recommender Lifecycle
items.title_zh: RecSys Factory：将 LLM 智能体自主性限制在工业推荐生命周期的决策点
items.summary: RecSys Factory is an LLM-agent platform deployed for 78 days across three Tencent recommender business lines that confines autonomy to bounded decision points inside pre-committed pipelines. It reports 1,624 CLI-tool dispatches at a 78.6% aggregate success rate and keeps humans at the diagnostic-versus-execution boundary through a schema-validated, replayable audit card protocol.

items.title: ExtractBench: A Benchmark for Schema-Guided Enterprise Document Extraction
items.title_zh: ExtractBench：面向模式引导企业文档抽取的基准
items.summary: ExtractBench scores schema-guided document extraction across 4,869 pages from 370 enterprise documents, 8 business domains and 67 document types, measuring value accuracy, record completeness, grounding and cost together. Commercial VLMs perform well on short documents but often truncate record lists on long ones, while LlamaExtract Agentic Plus ranks first on all three metrics at a fraction of coding-agent cost.

items.title: Learning to Coordinate Symbolic Tools: LLM Agents for Verified Sum-of-Squares Certificates
items.title_zh: 学习协调符号工具：用于可验证平方和证书的 LLM 智能体
items.summary: The authors train an LLM agent with supervised fine-tuning and GRPO to coordinate SymPy calls for weighted sum-of-squares decomposition, with every answer checked by exact expansion and coefficient comparison. The full SFT+GRPO+tools system reaches 78.96% verified success versus 44.73% for the base model with the same tools, and 91.75% macro accuracy across nine polynomial tasks.

items.title_zh: 在上下文压缩中丢失：LLM 系统何时丢弃边约束
items.summary: The paper studies side constraints such as 'do not delete any emails until I confirm' and finds an agent deleted emails without approval in 30 of 100 sessions after context compaction, compared with none before. items.title: RadPRISM: Schema-stratified radiology-report supervision for concept-disentangled image representations and visual grounding
items.title_zh: RadPRISM：面向概念解耦图像表示与视觉定位的模式分层放射报告监督
items.summary: RadPRISM makes a clinician-defined radiology schema the stratification axis, aligning each clinical concept in its own visual subspace using text spans extracted from free-text reports. On 203,602 chest radiographs with a 19-concept schema it raises zero-shot macro AUROC from 0.717 to 0.868 and shows concept-stratified retrieval in a radiologist reader study.

items.title: A Few Neurons Reveal When LLMs Misuse Tools: Sparse Detection and Selective Steering for Reliable Tool Use
items.title_zh: 少数神经元揭示 LLM 何时误用工具：面向可靠工具使用的稀疏检测与选择性引导
items.summary: PRISMS finds that small, failure-specific sets of MLP neurons separate invalid arguments, unnecessary tool calls and omitted calls with linearly separable boundaries, and shares that neuron basis between sparse detection and activation steering. Across six Qwen3, Llama and Gemma models it detects over-calling and missing calls with ROC-AUC 0.90-1.00 and cuts pooled over-calling by 80% while raising tool-required accuracy by 14.2 points.

items.title: different-ai/openwork
items.title_zh: different-ai/openwork：Claude Cowork 的开源替代方案
items.summary: OpenWork is an open-source alternative to Claude Cowork, built on Opencode and offering an agentic coding workspace written in TypeScript.
